pages.text: The $(item)Entity Detector$() scans the area around it at a set interval and gives a redstone signal based on how many matching entities it finds.$(br2)$(li)$(l)Basic$(): range 1-16 blocks, scans every 1.5 to 60 seconds, filters players and hostile mobs.
$(li)$(l)Advanced$(): range up to 64 blocks, scans as often as every 0.25 seconds, and has the full filter: mob types, specific players, items and more.$(br2)Both store 512,000 OP and need power.

pages.title: Signal and cost
pages.text: Each scan costs energy, and it rises steeply with range: about 4,000 OP at range 10 and 64,000 OP at range 64. Keep the range as small as the job allows.$(br2)$(li)$(l)RS Min / RS Max$(): set the entity counts that give the weakest and strongest signal. Set both to the same number for a plain on/off signal once that many are found.
$(li)$(l)Pulse mode$(): sends a short pulse after each scan instead of a steady signal.
